definitions.explanation: The period of human history before the invention of writing systems. In Japanese history, this generally refers to the time before the earliest written records, ending roughly with the introduction of Chinese characters.

examples.japanese: {先史|せんし}{時代|じだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{先史|せんし}{時代|じだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{石器|せっき}→石器：19665_sekki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: People in prehistoric times used stone tools.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先史|せんし}{時代|じだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This museum has exhibits ranging from prehistoric times to the present.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{先史|せんし}→先史：23398_senshi⟧ (prehistory, before written history) and ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (era, period). Commonly encountered in museum descriptions, history textbooks, and cultural discussions. In Japan, the Jomon period is the most well-known part of the prehistoric era.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先史|せんし}{時代|じだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧: prehistoric ruins
- {先史|せんし}{時代|じだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人類|じんるい}→人類：01578_jinrui⟧: prehistoric humans
- {先史|せんし}{時代|じだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: prehistoric culture
- {先史|せんし}{時代|じだい}⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧: prehistoric studies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {有史|ゆうし}⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧: before recorded history — a more literary way to say the same thing
- ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧: ancient times — the period after writing was developed, not before
- ⟦{原始|げんし}{時代|じだい}→原始時代：25951_genshijidai⟧: primitive era — focuses on the level of technology and social development, not the presence of writing
